final_message:
All tests are now passing. The fix involved two changes to the `slugify` function:

1. Changed the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` (single character replacement) to `[^a-z0-9]+` (one or more characters), so consecutive non-alphanumeric characters are replaced with a single dash instead of multiple dashes.

2. Added `.strip("-")` at the end to remove any leading or trailing dashes that might result from special characters at the beginning or end of the text.
